persona: Public pseudo-user developing an agent memory layer where Dream work must stay source-backed and non-foreground.

source_events.speaker: user
source_events.text: Do not run a model extraction pass in the foreground after every turn. Dream work belongs in bounded background jobs; the prompt path must remain quick.

source_events.speaker: assistant
source_events.text: Dream candidates are hypotheses. They can guide later review, but raw dream output is not source truth and cannot be quoted as evidence without a clean-source event.

source_events.speaker: user
source_events.text: A candidate can become durable only after source support or explicit user confirmation. Without that, it should stay unknown or be suppressed.
